relocationRecipe: Map.luau keeps every relocated datum in its OLD coordinates in the source (reviewable diff) and adds Map.Relocations = { [id] = { from = {x, z}, to = {x, z}, turn = 0|90|180|270 } }.
Map.relocate(id, x, z) / relocateDir(id, dx, dz) / relocateRect(id, rect): new = to + R(turn)·(old − from); R(90): (dx, dz) → (−dz, dx) (clockwise on the map, north up).

One pass at load, right after the raw tables and BEFORE anything derived (Venues, Landmarks, makeLots' free(), addresses, Explore): Yards, Clearings, Places (x, z, nx, nz), Secrets (x, z; y unchanged), EmployerSpots, CargoSpots (park, pile; facing recomputed), FreightDocks, ReceivingDocks, EstatePlots (x, z, facing), Towers (x, z, facing), VanSeller (all its spots, facing), SunsetDrive untouched.
Map.raw keeps the unrelocated copies (Yards, EmployerSpots, CargoSpots, EstatePlots, VanSeller, Places, Secrets) for World's builders.

World: a relocated far place is built as today into its own folder, its builder reading Map.raw (yardOf → raw), then the folder is moved rigidly: PivotTo(CFrame.new(to) * CFrame.Angles(0, −rad(turn), 0) * CFrame.new(−from) * old pivot), parts and prompts move with it.

World: side effects outside the folder are moved by hand: Terrain fills (the lodge's snow hill → relocate the point), the employer NPCs (World.EmployerNpcs[id]: PivotTo the same transform), Earl (World.VanSeller.npc and its spots), World.EstateSpawns / EstateGarages of the four moved estates (their builders are plot-relative: they read the RELOCATED plot and need no folder move; only their literal pieces — Ocean View's sea pier, palms and rocks, Lakeside's frozen-lake jetty — are rewritten for the alpine lake).
Harbor specials move by whole cells: change Map.SpecialBlocks.harbor keys; their builders are block-relative (cx, cz) and read the relocated CargoSpots / FreightDocks / Towers, so no folder move.
